single_lesion_threshold_vs_impression_co.interpretation: concordance between RECIST-informed single-lesion thresholds and the impression-driven label on instances carrying both; quantitative tier decides the label by construction, so only the definitive (impression-driven) subset is informative

multi_channel_convergence.interpretation: internal multi-channel corroboration: how many semi-independent evidence channels (dual-audited impression conclusion, RECIST-informed quantitative thresholds, findings directional language) concordantly support each primary label; machine-only substitute for inter-rater reliability reporting

adjudication.design: blinded, randomized order; 60 each progression/regression/mixed + 120 stable + all remaining metastasis-positive + up to 30 additional postoperative-flagged progression; seed 20260904
adjudication.blinding: Optional blinded adjudication artifacts were generated during audit but omitted from this clean release.
